quarterly_data.quarter: Pacific Biosciences press release: PacBio and Verily Health Announce Multi-Year Strategic (10-19-2026)
quarterly_data.signal: PacBio and Verily Health announced a multi-year strategic collaboration to integrate PacBio HiFi sequencing with Verily Health's governed data and AI platform: Verily will configure Pre Workbench to connect PacBio sequencing workflows for aggregating, analyzing and curating HiFi genomic datasets, combining long-read genomic data with real-world clinical data at population scale to produce AI-ready clinico-genomic datasets for biomedical discovery and AI model training, and the companies plan to use the Verily Pre trusted agentic environment for model training and inference. PacBio HiFi whole-genome sequencing workflows already run end-to-end within Verily Pre; Workbench serves more than 20,000 researchers.
quarterly_data.figure: multi-year collaboration; Workbench serves more than 20,000 researchers
